summary: Samples a TOP using POP attribute values as texture indices, reads RGBA values, and writes them into POP attributes. It can sample 2D textures through U/V attributes and 3D texture TOPs with W.
key_concepts: Uses POP attributes as U/V lookup coordinates to sample RGBA values from a TOP into POP attributes.
Normalized index mode maps 0-1 across the image while pixel-index mode uses explicit pixel coordinates.
Lookup Attribute W enables 3D Texture TOP sampling when a depth component is provided.
Pixel-centered sampling, input extend modes, interpolation, and Channel Mask control how texture samples become attribute values.
common_gotchas: Normalized U/V values map 0 to the first pixel and 1 to the last pixel.
Pixel Index mode uses actual pixel coordinates, not normalized values.
Use W lookup only when sampling a 3D texture TOP.
